label: Alternative R&B
description: intimate, spacious R&B with inventive textures, flexible grooves, and an expressive vocal.

client_references.explanation: Broad alternative R&B and Afro-soul reference for expressive vocal presence and inventive texture; not an exclusive category or a voice to copy.

production_traits.musical_identity: alternative R&B: intimate, uncluttered R&B with deliberate negative space, inventive selected textures, flexible groove and an expressive close vocal
instrumentation: restrained bass line with warm sub weight
dry or unusual percussion, clipped and close
selected textural guitar, keyboard or synth touches
sparse kick and snare with syncopated gaps
optional layered vocal harmony on the returning phrase
production_traits.rhythm: ordinarily 4/4 with a syncopated, flexible pocket when the words support it; silence and gaps are part of the groove

tempo.note: flexible pocket; tempo chosen from the story's energy, not from a default slow tempo

production_traits.vocal_delivery: expressive, close lead with purposeful rests, original melodic shapes and optional layered vocal harmony that keeps words easy to hear, dry upfront vocal

energy_map.consequence: a small textural gesture underscores the consequence before the groove arrives
energy_map.obstacle: space and harmonic friction expose the contradiction
energy_map.choice: percussion drops out, leaving the decision in negative space
energy_map.change: harmony, register or rhythmic density shifts after the consequential choice
energy_map.hook: understated but recognizable hook expresses the earned change
energy_map.cta: final hook thins to the close lead and one texture under the CTA

production_traits.hook_guidance: the hook may be understated but must be recognizable and must express the earned change; nonstandard form is allowed only when the scene plan and duration stay coherent
production_traits.spoken_sung_split: spoken, rap and sung parts follow their elected sheet tags; nothing is inferred from the genre, and no rap is added by default
production_traits.delivery_constraints: keep words easy to hear over the texture; preserve selected language, gender and accent; no artist reference or alias enters production fields
production_traits.word_fit: negative space counts as intentional time, not missing lyrics; leave space around important names and breath-driven phrasing
production_traits.story_energy: mood chosen from the approved story: warm, tense, playful or confident; never automatically slow, sad or whispered

duration_guidance.60: one texture, one consequential turn, one hook and the CTA; rests are preserved, not filled
duration_guidance.90: two short sections with a textural break before the decision
duration_guidance.120: keeps meaningful rests and protected words; one harmonic shift after the choice
duration_guidance.180: adds a second texture and one instrumental passage that advances the story
duration_guidance.300: three scenes, a stripped middle section, hook phrase returns re-harmonized
duration_guidance.600: long-form with a second act and evolving textures; no instrumental meandering and no repeated filler

examples: The unanswered phone rings into a sparse beat; after the lead answers, a warmer harmony changes the returning melodic phrase.

section_hint: [Verse] close and uncluttered, [Hook] understated but clear, [Break] textural turn, [Hook] changed phrase
negative_constraints: no artist name or alias in any production field
